summary: The /bond-analysis route is frontend-ready and now has a direct route-specific Gate I readiness gap lane, but it still does not have direct page contract closure, golden-sample boundary, governance-validation evidence, manual audit review, or business-owner approval. Do not certify it by borrowing /bond-dashboard evidence.

browser_surface_evidence.evidence_scope: Browser evidence proves page-surface runtime cleanliness and mobile readout ordering only. It does not prove business-contract certification, golden-sample approval, governance closure, or business-owner approval.

readiness_gap.implication: There is now a direct machine-checkable gap lane for /bond-analysis. It routes the page for smoke and verification but does not provide direct page-contract closure, golden-sample approval, governance validation, audit review, or business-owner approval.

non_reusable_evidence.boundary: PAGE-BOND-001 names route /bond-dashboard and GET /api/bond-dashboard/*, including /api/bond-dashboard/headline-kpis.
GS-BOND-HEADLINE-A is captured from GET /api/bond-dashboard/headline-kpis?report_date=2026-03-31 and has status captured-awaiting-approval.
MTR-BOND-001 through MTR-BOND-004 are candidate bond-dashboard headline metrics bound to PAGE-BOND-001 and GS-BOND-HEADLINE-A.

fixed_income_conventions_to_preserve: yield or YTM displayed as percent
curve or spread movement displayed in bp where applicable
stale, fallback, no-data, temporary-exception, and formal/candidate status markers
required_closure_work: Add or map a direct /bond-analysis page contract if this route is meant to be Gate I certified.
Use the direct bond-analysis readiness slug as the route-specific gap lane without conflating it with bond-dashboard.
Collect metric-contract, lineage, catalog/date, and governance evidence for /api/bond-analytics/* surfaces used by BondAnalyticsView.
Define a golden-sample boundary for bond-analysis if any displayed fixed-income decision metrics are to be certified.
Run manual audit review and capture business-owner approval before any certification wording.
forbidden_claims: PAGE-BOND-001 covers BondAnalyticsView without an explicit alias decision
Browser cleanliness proves fixed-income metric correctness
Bond dashboard candidate MTR-BOND metrics approve bond-analysis DV01, duration, yield, PnL, KRD, credit-spread, or holdings metrics
allowed_claim: The /bond-analysis frontend surface is ready under the recorded browser checks, but Gate I business-contract certification is blocked by a direct route readiness and evidence-boundary gap.
